corrected_claim: The Great Depression of 1929 saw the U.S. stock market (Dow Jones) fall approximately 89% from its 1929 peak to the 1932 trough, not quite 90% but very close.
notes: Dow fell from 381.17 (Sept 1929) to 41.22 (July 1932) = 89.2%. Nearly 90% is a reasonable approximation.
